tbesh_html:
1) to bare, polish, make smooth or bald or bare
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to make bare
1a2) to scour, polish
1b) (Niphal) to be made bald

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to polish; by implication, to make bald (the head), to gall (the shoulder); also, to sharpen
strongs_1890.kjv_def: bright, furbish, (have his) hair (be) fallen off, peeled, pluck off (hair).
